description: 27 steps with doLimitedCrafting on, at a crafting table and in the own window: oak_planks taken away while a log's planks show, an empty slot clicked, the logs moved and swapped by a number key (the result stays), the result shift-clicked out (taken; the recipe given back), another log; taken away again, a log (nothing), the recipe given and a click elsewhere (still nothing), the log picked up and put back (the planks); then at the table with the recipe unknown, planks with the rule off, the rule turned on and a click elsewhere (they stay), the log picked up and put back (nothing), the rule turned off (still nothing); Circuit and both official servers give identical windows and recipe book packets
